title: Choose with if
summary: Elixir: Choose with if. Try score 3. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: if picks one of two branches. Only false and nil count as false in Elixir.

blocks.text: Install Elixir. Save each example as lesson.exs and run elixir lesson.exs.

blocks.title: Choose with if
blocks.code:
score = 8
IO.puts(if score >= 5, do: "Pass", else: "Try again")

blocks.text: The true condition chooses the do value Pass.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Zero is a true value, so test a number with an explicit rule.
